verdict.rationale: Google Workspace is a SaaS productivity platform, so an official MCP server is a fair question to ask. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions one. The pack covers only admin APIs (Directory, Reports), Apps Script, the Marketplace, and Gemini features. Those are developer building blocks or adjacent features, not an MCP server.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
